title: Hotel Investing at EOS – Jonathan Wang (EP.506)

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Jonathan Wang is the founder and CEO of EOS Investors.
reader_summary.overview: Jonathan Wang is the founder and CEO of EOS Investors. Jonathan also created a wholly owned hotel management company that oversees 60 properties for the EOS funds and five core partners. Our conversation covers Jonathan's path to hotel investing and EOS' hotel investment process across market selection, property type, underwriting, vertically integrated operations, and managing through cycles.

key_points.text: Jonathan Wang is the founder and CEO of EOS Investors.
We also discuss extensions into residential real estate, hotel credit, and opportunities and risks going forward.
